verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an LLM inference platform, but the evidence only describes Groq as a hosted API reached at api.groq.com with a Groq API key. Nothing documents a self-hostable or on-prem deployment of Groq's own product. Support for open-weight models like GPT-OSS concerns the models, not self-hosting Groq itself, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
